typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		metric_Date as string,
		CaseCreationDate as string,
		Dept as string,
		Aging as integer,
		Aging_Bucket as string,
		CCY as string,
		DIRECTION as string,
		GSMOSSTATUS as string,
		SWIFTSTATUS as string,
		rate as string,
		Description as string,
		Desc1 as string,
		Desc2 as string,
		Nostro as string,
		Side as string,
		{D C} as string,
		INVESTIGATOR as string,
		Notes as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		Deal_Number as string,
		Deal_Source as string,
		Item_ID as string,
		midasDealNumber as string,
		Source as string,
		Unique_ID_MP as string,
		OpsControlDesc as string,
		PgDesignation as string,
		Outstanding_Cases as integer,
		L1_amberThreshold as string,
		L1_redThreshold as string,
		Case_ID as string,
		Case_type as string,
		Case_Sub_Type as string,
		Case_Status as string,
		Next_Action_Date as string,
		CCY_Amount as string,
		USD_Equiv_Amt as string,
		Value_date as string,
		Covering_Employee_Name as string,
		User_Update_Date_Time as string,
		Customer_Legal_Name as string,
		Tran_Ref as string,
		Incoming_TRN as string,
		CMR_ID as string,
		Source_Reference as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of DIRECTION} = DIRECTION,
		{Copy of CaseCreationDate} = CaseCreationDate,
		{Copy of Source_Reference} = Source_Reference,
		{Copy of Aging_Bucket} = Aging_Bucket,
		{Copy of USD_Equiv_Amt} = USD_Equiv_Amt,
		{Copy of SWIFTSTATUS} = SWIFTSTATUS,
		{Copy of rate} = rate,
		{Copy of Desc2} = Desc2,
		{Copy of CCY_Amount} = CCY_Amount,
		{Copy of Desc1} = Desc1,
		{Copy of metric_Date} = metric_Date,
		{Copy of L1_amberThreshold} = L1_amberThreshold,
		{Copy of Value_date} = Value_date,
		{Copy of Side} = Side,
		{Copy of Tran_Ref} = Tran_Ref,
		{Copy of OpsControlDesc} = OpsControlDesc,
		{Copy of Incoming_TRN} = Incoming_TRN,
		{Copy of Aging} = Aging,
		{Copy of Deal_Source} = Deal_Source,
		{Copy of Description} = Description,
		{Copy of Case_Status} = Case_Status,
		{Copy of Item_ID} = Item_ID,
		{Copy of Case_Sub_Type} = Case_Sub_Type,
		{Copy of CMR_ID} = CMR_ID,
		{Copy of Outstanding_Cases} = Outstanding_Cases,
		{Copy of User_Update_Date_Time} = User_Update_Date_Time,
		{Copy of GSMOSSTATUS} = GSMOSSTATUS,
		{Copy of Covering_Employee_Name} = Covering_Employee_Name,
		{Copy of Deal_Number} = Deal_Number,
		{Copy of Case_ID} = Case_ID,
		{Copy of Notes} = Notes,
		{Copy of CCY} = CCY,
		{Copy of Customer_Legal_Name} = Customer_Legal_Name,
		{Copy of L1_redThreshold} = L1_redThreshold,
		{Copy of INVESTIGATOR} = INVESTIGATOR,
		{Copy of Next_Action_Date} = Next_Action_Date,
		{Copy of Case_type} = Case_type,
		{Copy of Source} = Source,
		{Copy of Unique_ID_MP} = Unique_ID_MP,
		{Copy of Customer_Name} = Customer_Name,
		{Copy of PgDesignation} = toInteger(PgDesignation),
		{Copy of midasDealNumber} = midasDealNumber,
		{Copy of Dept} = Dept,
		{Copy of Nostro} = Nostro) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Description as string,
		Customer_Name as string,
		Case_Status as string,
		Customer_Legal_Name as string,
		Dept as string,
		Deal_Source as string,
		Outstanding_cases as integer,
		D_C as string,
		Case_Type as string,
		Desc2 as string,
		Direction as string,
		Desc1 as string,
		Source as string,
		User_Update_Date_Time as string,
		Side as string,
		MidasDealnumber as string,
		USD_Equiv_Amount as string,
		Nostro as string,
		Next_Action_Date as string,
		Tran_Ref as string,
		Covering_Employee_Name as string,
		CasecreationDate as string,
		Notes as string,
		Age as integer,
		Case_ID as string,
		GSMOSSTATUS as string,
		Aging_Bucket as string,
		L1_redThreshold as string,
		Case_Sub_Type as string,
		Rate as string,
		metric_Date as string,
		Amount as string,
		Incoming_Tran as string,
		L1_amberthreshold as string,
		OpsControlDesc as string,
		CMR_ID as string,
		Unique_ID_MP as string,
		PgDestination as integer,
		Deal_Number as string,
		INVESTIGATOR as string,
		CCY as string,
		SWIFTSTATUS as string,
		Source_Reference as string,
		Item_ID as string,
		value_date as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Description,
		Customer_Name,
		Case_Status,
		Customer_Legal_Name,
		Dept,
		Deal_Source,
		Outstanding_cases = Outstanding_Cases,
		D_C = {D C},
		Case_Type = Case_type,
		Desc2,
		Direction = DIRECTION,
		Desc1,
		Source,
		User_Update_Date_Time,
		Side,
		MidasDealnumber = midasDealNumber,
		USD_Equiv_Amount = USD_Equiv_Amt,
		Nostro,
		Next_Action_Date = {Copy of Next_Action_Date},
		Tran_Ref,
		Covering_Employee_Name,
		CasecreationDate = {Copy of CaseCreationDate},
		Notes,
		Age = Aging,
		Case_ID,
		GSMOSSTATUS,
		Aging_Bucket,
		L1_redThreshold,
		Case_Sub_Type,
		Rate = rate,
		metric_Date = {Copy of metric_Date},
		Amount = CCY_Amount,
		Incoming_Tran = Incoming_TRN,
		L1_amberthreshold = L1_amberThreshold,
		OpsControlDesc,
		CMR_ID,
		Unique_ID_MP,
		PgDestination = {Copy of PgDesignation},
		Deal_Number,
		INVESTIGATOR,
		CCY,
		SWIFTSTATUS,
		Source_Reference,
		Item_ID,
		value_date = Value_date),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
